stem: Which substrate does the insulin receptor act on?
rationale: The insulin receptor subunits are linked by multiple disulfide bonds.

stem: Which substance is secreted by the pituitary gland?
rationale: The pituitary gland produces thyroid-stimulating hormone [TSH], follicle-stimulating hormone [FSH], luteinizing hormone [LH], growth hormone [GH], PRL, and adrenocorticotropic hormone [ACTH].
citation: chapter_41_the_diversity_of_the_endocrine_system — The Diversity of the Endocrine System > HORMONES CAN BE CLASSIFIED IN SEVERAL WAYS > Hormones Are Synthesized in a Variety of Cellular Arrangements

stem: Which substance is secreted by the ovaries?
rationale: The ovaries produce mature oocytes and the reproductive hormones estradiol and progesterone. The testes produce mature spermatozoa and testosterone.
citation: chapter_41_the_diversity_of_the_endocrine_system — The Diversity of the Endocrine System > HORMONES CAN BE CLASSIFIED IN SEVERAL WAYS > Hormones Are Synthesized in a Variety of Cellular Arrangements

stem: Which substance is secreted by the testes?
rationale: The testes produce mature spermatozoa and testosterone.
citation: chapter_41_the_diversity_of_the_endocrine_system — The Diversity of the Endocrine System > HORMONES CAN BE CLASSIFIED IN SEVERAL WAYS > Hormones Are Synthesized in a Variety of Cellular Arrangements

stem: Which substance is secreted by the thyroid gland?
rationale: The thyroid produces calcitonin. The kidney produces angiotensin II.
citation: chapter_41_the_diversity_of_the_endocrine_system — The Diversity of the Endocrine System > HORMONES CAN BE CLASSIFIED IN SEVERAL WAYS > Hormones Are Synthesized in a Variety of Cellular Arrangements

stem: Which substance is secreted by the kidney?
rationale: The kidney produces angiotensin II.
citation: chapter_41_the_diversity_of_the_endocrine_system — The Diversity of the Endocrine System > HORMONES CAN BE CLASSIFIED IN SEVERAL WAYS > Hormones Are Synthesized in a Variety of Cellular Arrangements

stem: What substance is progesterone converted into?
rationale: Progesterone is a precursor in the formation of glucocorticoids, mineralocorticoids, testosterone, and estrogens.
citation: chapter_41_the_diversity_of_the_endocrine_system — The Diversity of the Endocrine System > HORMONES CAN BE CLASSIFIED IN SEVERAL WAYS > Hormones Are Chemically Diverse

stem: What substance is testosterone converted into?
rationale: Testosterone is an obligatory intermediate in the formation of dihydrotestosterone (DHT).
citation: chapter_41_the_diversity_of_the_endocrine_system — The Diversity of the Endocrine System > HORMONES CAN BE CLASSIFIED IN SEVERAL WAYS > Hormones Are Chemically Diverse

stem: What substance is plasma converted into?
rationale: The adrenal steroid hormones are synthesized from cholesterol, which is mostly derived from the plasma.
citation: chapter_41_the_diversity_of_the_endocrine_system — The Diversity of the Endocrine System > HORMONES CAN BE CLASSIFIED IN SEVERAL WAYS > Adrenal Steroidogenesis

stem: What substance is acetyl-CoA converted into?
rationale: A small portion of cholesterol is synthesized in situ from acetyl-CoA via mevalonate and squalene.
citation: chapter_41_the_diversity_of_the_endocrine_system — The Diversity of the Endocrine System > HORMONES CAN BE CLASSIFIED IN SEVERAL WAYS > Adrenal Steroidogenesis

stem: Mevalonate is converted into which substance?
rationale: A small portion of cholesterol is synthesized in situ from acetyl-CoA via mevalonate and squalene.
citation: chapter_41_the_diversity_of_the_endocrine_system — The Diversity of the Endocrine System > HORMONES CAN BE CLASSIFIED IN SEVERAL WAYS > Adrenal Steroidogenesis

stem: Cholesterol is found within which structure?
rationale: Much of the cholesterol in the adrenal is esterified and stored in cytoplasmic lipid droplets.
citation: chapter_41_the_diversity_of_the_endocrine_system — The Diversity of the Endocrine System > HORMONES CAN BE CLASSIFIED IN SEVERAL WAYS > Adrenal Steroidogenesis

stem: Which substance is stored in cytoplasmic lipid droplets?
rationale: Much of the cholesterol in the adrenal is esterified and stored in cytoplasmic lipid droplets.
citation: chapter_41_the_diversity_of_the_endocrine_system — The Diversity of the Endocrine System > HORMONES CAN BE CLASSIFIED IN SEVERAL WAYS > Adrenal Steroidogenesis

stem: P450scc acts on which substrate?
rationale: A cytochrome P450 side chain cleavage enzyme (P450scc) converts cholesterol to pregnenolone in the mitochondrion.
citation: chapter_41_the_diversity_of_the_endocrine_system — The Diversity of the Endocrine System > HORMONES CAN BE CLASSIFIED IN SEVERAL WAYS > Adrenal Steroidogenesis

stem: Cholesterol is converted into which substance?
rationale: A cytochrome P450 side chain cleavage enzyme (P450scc) converts cholesterol to pregnenolone in the mitochondrion.
citation: chapter_41_the_diversity_of_the_endocrine_system — The Diversity of the Endocrine System > HORMONES CAN BE CLASSIFIED IN SEVERAL WAYS > Adrenal Steroidogenesis

stem: Hydroxylases require which substance?
rationale: Hydroxylases that require molecular oxygen and NADPH are essential for steroid hormone formation.
citation: chapter_41_the_diversity_of_the_endocrine_system — The Diversity of the Endocrine System > HORMONES CAN BE CLASSIFIED IN SEVERAL WAYS > Adrenal Steroidogenesis

stem: 18-hydroxylase is found within which structure?
rationale: 18-hydroxylase is found only in the zona glomerulosa cells.
citation: chapter_41_the_diversity_of_the_endocrine_system — The Diversity of the Endocrine System > HORMONES CAN BE CLASSIFIED IN SEVERAL WAYS > Adrenal Steroidogenesis

stem: 18-hydroxylase acts on which substrate?
rationale: The 18-hydroxylase (aldosterone synthase) acts on corticosterone to form 18-hydroxycorticosterone. 18-hydroxycorticosterone is changed to aldosterone by conversion of the 18-alcohol to an aldehyde.
citation: chapter_41_the_diversity_of_the_endocrine_system — The Diversity of the Endocrine System > HORMONES CAN BE CLASSIFIED IN SEVERAL WAYS > Mineralocorticoid Synthesis

stem: Corticosterone is converted into which substance?
rationale: The 18-hydroxylase (aldosterone synthase) acts on corticosterone to form 18-hydroxycorticosterone. 18-hydroxycorticosterone is changed to aldosterone by conversion of the 18-alcohol to an aldehyde.
citation: chapter_41_the_diversity_of_the_endocrine_system — The Diversity of the Endocrine System > HORMONES CAN BE CLASSIFIED IN SEVERAL WAYS > Mineralocorticoid Synthesis

stem: 18-hydroxycorticosterone is converted into which substance?
rationale: 18-hydroxycorticosterone is changed to aldosterone by conversion of the 18-alcohol to an aldehyde.
citation: chapter_41_the_diversity_of_the_endocrine_system — The Diversity of the Endocrine System > HORMONES CAN BE CLASSIFIED IN SEVERAL WAYS > Mineralocorticoid Synthesis

stem: Fasciculata is part of which structure?
rationale: Cortisol synthesis requires three hydroxylases located in the fasciculata and reticularis zones of the adrenal cortex.
citation: chapter_41_the_diversity_of_the_endocrine_system — The Diversity of the Endocrine System > HORMONES CAN BE CLASSIFIED IN SEVERAL WAYS > Glucocorticoid Synthesis

stem: Reticularis zones are part of which structure?
rationale: Cortisol synthesis requires three hydroxylases located in the fasciculata and reticularis zones of the adrenal cortex.
citation: chapter_41_the_diversity_of_the_endocrine_system — The Diversity of the Endocrine System > HORMONES CAN BE CLASSIFIED IN SEVERAL WAYS > Glucocorticoid Synthesis

stem: Which substance is secreted by the adrenal cortex?
rationale: The major androgen or androgen precursor produced by the adrenal cortex is dehydroepiandrosterone (DHEA). Most 17-hydroxypregnenolone follows the glucocorticoid pathway.
citation: chapter_41_the_diversity_of_the_endocrine_system — The Diversity of the Endocrine System > HORMONES CAN BE CLASSIFIED IN SEVERAL WAYS > Androgen Synthesis

stem: Estrogens are converted into which substance?
rationale: Estrogens are formed by the aromatization of androgens in a complex process that involves three hydroxylation steps.
citation: chapter_41_the_diversity_of_the_endocrine_system — The Diversity of the Endocrine System > HORMONES CAN BE CLASSIFIED IN SEVERAL WAYS > Ovarian Steroidogenesis

stem: Aromatase acts on which substrate?
rationale: Granulosa cells convert androstenedione to estrone using the aromatase enzyme.
citation: chapter_41_the_diversity_of_the_endocrine_system — The Diversity of the Endocrine System > HORMONES CAN BE CLASSIFIED IN SEVERAL WAYS > Ovarian Steroidogenesis

stem: Which substance is secreted by theca cells?
rationale: Theca cells are the source of androstenedione and testosterone.
citation: chapter_41_the_diversity_of_the_endocrine_system — The Diversity of the Endocrine System > HORMONES CAN BE CLASSIFIED IN SEVERAL WAYS > Ovarian Steroidogenesis

stem: Which substance is secreted by corpus luteum cells?
rationale: The corpus luteum produces and secretes progesterone as an end-product hormone.
citation: chapter_41_the_diversity_of_the_endocrine_system — The Diversity of the Endocrine System > HORMONES CAN BE CLASSIFIED IN SEVERAL WAYS > Ovarian Steroidogenesis

stem: Cytochrome P450 reductase acts on which substrate?
rationale: Two enzymes are involved in 25-hydroxylation: an NADPH-dependent cytochrome P450 reductase and a cytochrome P450.
citation: chapter_41_the_diversity_of_the_endocrine_system — The Diversity of the Endocrine System > HORMONES CAN BE CLASSIFIED IN SEVERAL WAYS > Liver

stem: Cytochrome P450 acts on which substrate?
rationale: Two enzymes are involved in 25-hydroxylation: an NADPH-dependent cytochrome P450 reductase and a cytochrome P450.
citation: chapter_41_the_diversity_of_the_endocrine_system — The Diversity of the Endocrine System > HORMONES CAN BE CLASSIFIED IN SEVERAL WAYS > Liver

stem: Chromaffin cells are found within which structure?
rationale: Dopamine, norepinephrine, and epinephrine are synthesized from tyrosine in the chromaffin cells of the adrenal medulla.
citation: chapter_41_the_diversity_of_the_endocrine_system — The Diversity of the Endocrine System > HORMONES CAN BE CLASSIFIED IN SEVERAL WAYS > Catecholamines Are Synthesized in Final Form & Stored in Secretion Granules

stem: In which structure is epinephrine found?
rationale: Epinephrine and norepinephrine may be produced and stored in different cells in the adrenal medulla.
citation: chapter_41_the_diversity_of_the_endocrine_system — The Diversity of the Endocrine System > HORMONES CAN BE CLASSIFIED IN SEVERAL WAYS > Catecholamines Are Synthesized in Final Form & Stored in Secretion Granules

stem: What substance is norepinephrine converted into?
rationale: The conversion of tyrosine to epinephrine requires four sequential steps: ring hydroxylation, decarboxylation, side chain hydroxylation to form norepinephrine, and N-methylation to form epinephrine.
citation: chapter_41_the_diversity_of_the_endocrine_system — The Diversity of the Endocrine System > HORMONES CAN BE CLASSIFIED IN SEVERAL WAYS > Catecholamines Are Synthesized in Final Form & Stored in Secretion Granules

stem: What substance is tyrosine converted into?
rationale: Tyrosine hydroxylase converts L-tyrosine to L-dihydroxyphenylalanine (L-dopa).
citation: chapter_41_the_diversity_of_the_endocrine_system — The Diversity of the Endocrine System > HORMONES CAN BE CLASSIFIED IN SEVERAL WAYS > Catecholamines Are Synthesized in Final Form & Stored in Secretion Granules

stem: What substance does dopa decarboxylase require?
rationale: Dopa decarboxylase is a soluble enzyme that requires pyridoxal phosphate for the conversion of L-dopa to 3,4-dihydroxyphenylethylamine (dopamine).
citation: chapter_41_the_diversity_of_the_endocrine_system — The Diversity of the Endocrine System > HORMONES CAN BE CLASSIFIED IN SEVERAL WAYS > Dopa Decarboxylase Is Present in All Tissues

stem: What substrate does PNMT act on?
rationale: Phenylethanolamine-N-Methyltransferase (PNMT) catalyzes the N-methylation of norepinephrine to form epinephrine.
citation: chapter_41_the_diversity_of_the_endocrine_system — The Diversity of the Endocrine System > HORMONES CAN BE CLASSIFIED IN SEVERAL WAYS > Phenylethanolamine-N-Methyltransferase (PNMT) Catalyzes the Production of Epinephrine

stem: What substance does triiodothyronine require?
rationale: Triiodothyronine and tetraiodothyronine require iodine for bioactivity.
citation: chapter_41_the_diversity_of_the_endocrine_system — The Diversity of the Endocrine System > HORMONES CAN BE CLASSIFIED IN SEVERAL WAYS > T3 & T4 Illustrate the Diversity in Hormone Synthesis

stem: What substance does tetraiodothyronine require?
rationale: Triiodothyronine and tetraiodothyronine require iodine for bioactivity.
citation: chapter_41_the_diversity_of_the_endocrine_system — The Diversity of the Endocrine System > HORMONES CAN BE CLASSIFIED IN SEVERAL WAYS > T3 & T4 Illustrate the Diversity in Hormone Synthesis

stem: What substance is synthesized by triiodothyronine?
rationale: Triiodothyronine and tetraiodothyronine are synthesized as part of a very large precursor molecule called thyroglobulin.
citation: chapter_41_the_diversity_of_the_endocrine_system — The Diversity of the Endocrine System > HORMONES CAN BE CLASSIFIED IN SEVERAL WAYS > T3 & T4 Illustrate the Diversity in Hormone Synthesis

stem: What substance is synthesized by tetraiodothyronine?
rationale: Triiodothyronine and tetraiodothyronine are synthesized as part of a very large precursor molecule called thyroglobulin.
citation: chapter_41_the_diversity_of_the_endocrine_system — The Diversity of the Endocrine System > HORMONES CAN BE CLASSIFIED IN SEVERAL WAYS > T3 & T4 Illustrate the Diversity in Hormone Synthesis

stem: What substance is synthesized by the thyroid?
rationale: The thyroid must synthesize thyronine from tyrosine.
citation: chapter_41_the_diversity_of_the_endocrine_system — The Diversity of the Endocrine System > HORMONES CAN BE CLASSIFIED IN SEVERAL WAYS > T3 & T4 Illustrate the Diversity in Hormone Synthesis

stem: Which substance is required by peroxidase as an oxidizing agent?
rationale: Thyroperoxidase requires hydrogen peroxide (H2O2) as an oxidizing agent. H2O2 is produced by an NADPH-dependent enzyme resembling cytochrome c reductase.
citation: chapter_41_the_diversity_of_the_endocrine_system — The Diversity of the Endocrine System > HORMONES CAN BE CLASSIFIED IN SEVERAL WAYS > Iodide Metabolism Involves Several Discrete Steps

stem: Proinsulin is converted into which substance?
rationale: Formation of the critical disulfide bridges in insulin requires that this hormone be first synthesized as part of a larger precursor molecule, proinsulin.
citation: chapter_41_the_diversity_of_the_endocrine_system — The Diversity of the Endocrine System > HORMONES CAN BE CLASSIFIED IN SEVERAL WAYS > Several Hormones Are Made From Larger Peptide Precursors

stem: Proinsulin requires which substance?
rationale: The removal of the leader sequence results in the 9000-MW proinsulin molecule, which provides the conformation necessary for the proper and efficient formation of the disulfide bridges.
citation: chapter_41_the_diversity_of_the_endocrine_system — The Diversity of the Endocrine System > HORMONES CAN BE CLASSIFIED IN SEVERAL WAYS > Insulin Is Synthesized as a Preprohormone & Modified Within the β Cell

stem: PTH1-34 is converted into which substance?
rationale: PTH1-36 is rapidly and progressively cleaved into di- and tripeptides.
citation: chapter_41_the_diversity_of_the_endocrine_system — The Diversity of the Endocrine System > HORMONES CAN BE CLASSIFIED IN SEVERAL WAYS > PTH Is Secreted as an 84-Amino-Acid Peptide

stem: Parathyroid hormone is found within which structure?
rationale: PTH is also proteolytically degraded in other tissues, especially the liver, by similar mechanisms.
citation: chapter_41_the_diversity_of_the_endocrine_system — The Diversity of the Endocrine System > HORMONES CAN BE CLASSIFIED IN SEVERAL WAYS > PTH Is Secreted as an 84-Amino-Acid Peptide

stem: Angiotensin II acts on which substrate?
rationale: Angiotensin II is an octapeptide involved in these processes.
citation: chapter_41_the_diversity_of_the_endocrine_system — The Diversity of the Endocrine System > HORMONES CAN BE CLASSIFIED IN SEVERAL WAYS > Angiotensin II Is Also Synthesized From a Large Precursor

stem: Renin acts on which substrate to produce angiotensin I?
rationale: Renin acts on angiotensinogen to produce the decapeptide angiotensin I.
citation: chapter_41_the_diversity_of_the_endocrine_system — The Diversity of the Endocrine System > HORMONES CAN BE CLASSIFIED IN SEVERAL WAYS > Angiotensin II Is Also Synthesized From a Large Precursor

stem: Pro-opiomelanocortin is converted into which substance?
rationale: POMC is synthesized as a pre-proprecursor molecule of 267 amino acids.
citation: chapter_41_the_diversity_of_the_endocrine_system — The Diversity of the Endocrine System > HORMONES CAN BE CLASSIFIED IN SEVERAL WAYS > Complex Processing Generates the Pro-Opiomelanocortin (POMC) Peptide Family

stem: The pituitary is part of which structure?
rationale: The intermediate lobe of the pituitary is active in human fetuses.
citation: chapter_41_the_diversity_of_the_endocrine_system — The Diversity of the Endocrine System > HORMONES CAN BE CLASSIFIED IN SEVERAL WAYS > Complex Processing Generates the Pro-Opiomelanocortin (POMC) Peptide Family

stem: Which substance is stored in chromaffin cells?
rationale: Catecholamines are stored in granules in the chromaffin cells in the adrenal medulla. Catecholamines are released into the circulation through exocytosis in response to neural stimulation.
citation: chapter_41_the_diversity_of_the_endocrine_system — The Diversity of the Endocrine System > THERE IS SIGNIFICANT VARIATION IN THE STORAGE & SECRETION OF HORMONES

stem: ProPTH is converted into which substance?
rationale: Up to 80 to 90% of proPTH synthesized is degraded before entering the final storage compartment. A several-hour supply of PTH is stored in the parathyroid cells.
citation: chapter_41_the_diversity_of_the_endocrine_system — The Diversity of the Endocrine System > THERE IS SIGNIFICANT VARIATION IN THE STORAGE & SECRETION OF HORMONES

stem: Which substance is secreted by the human pancreas?
rationale: The human pancreas secretes about 40 to 50 units of insulin daily. Insulin and C-peptide are secreted in equimolar amounts.
citation: chapter_41_the_diversity_of_the_endocrine_system — The Diversity of the Endocrine System > THERE IS SIGNIFICANT VARIATION IN THE STORAGE & SECRETION OF HORMONES

stem: Insulin is converted into which substance?
rationale: Insulin and C-peptide are secreted in equimolar amounts. Glucose provokes insulin secretion.
citation: chapter_41_the_diversity_of_the_endocrine_system — The Diversity of the Endocrine System > THERE IS SIGNIFICANT VARIATION IN THE STORAGE & SECRETION OF HORMONES

stem: Which substance is transported by TBG?
rationale: TBG is a glycoprotein with a molecular mass of 50 kDa. The small, unbound (free) fraction of thyroid hormones is responsible for the biological activity. TBG does not bind any other hormones.
citation: chapter_41_the_diversity_of_the_endocrine_system — The Diversity of the Endocrine System > SOME HORMONES HAVE PLASMA TRANSPORT PROTEINS > Thyroid Hormones Are Transported by Thyroid-Binding Globulin

stem: Amino acids are converted into which substance?
rationale: Hormones are synthesized from a number of precursor molecules, including cholesterol, tyrosine per se, and all the constituent amino acids of peptides and proteins.
citation: chapter_41_the_diversity_of_the_endocrine_system — The Diversity of the Endocrine System
